# API Response Information

Below is the response from an API call. To help you understand the data, I've provided:

1. A detailed description of all fields in the response structure
2. The complete API response

## Response Structure

> Content-Type: application/json

- **data**: 积分抽奖活动信息 (Type: object)
  - **data.status**: 业务状态 (Type: object)
    - **data.status.code**: 状态码，如 SUCCESS/NOT_LOGIN/NO_ACTIVITY/ACTIVITY_ERROR/ACTIVITY_EXPIRED (Type: string)
    - **data.status.message**: 状态文案 (Type: string)
  - **data.activityCode**: 活动号 (Type: string)
  - **data.activityStatusText**: 活动状态文案（未开始/进行中/已结束/活动不存在） (Type: string)
  - **data.activityName**: 活动名称 (Type: string)
  - **data.beginTime**: 活动开始时间 (Type: string)
  - **data.endTime**: 活动结束时间 (Type: string)
  - **data.drawPoint**: 单次所需积分 (Type: string)
  - **data.drawTypeText**: 抽奖消耗规则（无/消耗积分抽奖/消耗任务完成次数/先消耗次数再消耗积分抽奖） (Type: string)
  - **data.availableTimes**: 剩余可抽次数（消耗任务完成次数、先消耗次数再消耗积分时返回） (Type: integer)
  - **data.availablePoint**: 当前可用积分（消耗积分、先消耗次数再消耗积分时返回） (Type: string)
  - **data.drawDecision**: 服务端计算的资源决策；仅评估积分/次数资源，库存、人群、风控等以实际抽奖结果为准 (Type: object)
    - **data.drawDecision.resourceEligible**: 当前积分/次数资源是否满足本次抽奖 (Type: boolean)
    - **data.drawDecision.reason**: 资源不足原因；满足时为 null (Type: string)
    - **data.drawDecision.nextConsumption**: 本次实际消耗，type 为 NONE/POINTS/CHANCES (Type: object)
    - **data.drawDecision.fallbackConsumption**: 混合规则本次先消耗次数时的后续积分消耗说明；其他情况为 null (Type: object)
  - **data.prizes**: 奖品列表 (Type: array)
    - **data.prizes[].name**: 奖品名称 (Type: string)
    - **data.prizes[].imageUrl**: 奖品图片 (Type: string)
    - **data.prizes[].typeText**: 奖品类型文案 (Type: string)
- **message**: 响应消息 (Type: string)
